item.title: Temporary traffic lights in place over 2 years, permit ref EY40024464061-01, Manor Road, 8th September
item.description:
Temporary traffic lights have been in place on Manor Road junction for well over a year (current permit ref EY40024464061-01, spanning multiple renewed permits, description 'mains fail issue to be investigated'). The lights worked for about a week when first installed; since then the lights have remained in place for about two years with no visible works taking place. This is causing ongoing unnecessary traffic delay on a road where permanent traffic signals already exist and would handle traffic more efficiently. Please confirm: (1) what work has actually been completed under this and prior permits, (2) why an issue 'to be investigated' takes two years, and (3) when the temporary lights will be removed.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Manor Road, Kingsditch, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: The whole road/pavement needs resurfacing, 8th September
item.description:
The whole road/pavement of Hannam close needs resurfacing. It has probably never been resurfaced since the houses were built in the 1980's. There is a lot of loose gravel which must be washing in to the drains and possibly causing problems. There is constant traffic/parking from cars dropping off/picking up at Richard Pates school. Over the years this has completely worn out the road. Southern road, which Richard Pates is located on, has been resurfaced recently so why do we have to put up with the inconvenience of school traffic every week day, wearing out the already damaged road surface. Restrictions on traffic down Hannam close would prolong the life of the road, if it is eventually resurfaced.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 2, Hannam Close, Leckhampton, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: We would like double yellow lines outside the school, 8th September
item.description:
We would like double yellow lines painted on both sides of the road by the school entrances to stop people parking on the road and obstructing the access to the school and creating traffic backlogs at school drop off and pick up times. Parked cars, cause drivers to use our entrances to be able to move round the cars and this impacts the safety of our students leaving and arriving to school.
